reason: A plate of basil pork from the stall downstairs is 50 baht and nobody has to wash up, so I only cook when I have time. I might open the free dishes in my browser one evening, but I won't pay 99 baht up front for a pack I can't use yet.
objection: My kitchen is tiny and I have one pan. Green curry and braised pork with eggs sound like they need a pot and a long time, and I already watch free cooking clips every night, so why pay for recipes?
would_change_my_mind: If I cooked the free dishes a few times in my one pan and they came out better than my usual, and the 12-dish pack said which dishes work with one pan and finish in about 20 minutes.
